annotation_audit.actual_annotation_method: Heuristic lexicon matching, regex gazetteers, and programmatic suffix stripping in Python
annotation_audit.verdict: The candidate dataset was programmatically pre-annotated using dictionary matching rules rather than authenticated human annotation. Training on these machine labels under the premise of genuine Gold supervision violates scientific protocol.

recommended_action: Implement a human-in-the-loop review interface or expert native speaker verification pass for the 710 pre-annotated candidate sentences before executing large-gold retraining.
